lines.en: label day295:
scene tsubasaofficevisit1
: Do you mind if I ask why you’re sitting on my desk?
lines.zh: : 我能问一下，你为什么坐在我桌子上吗？

lines.en: : Would you prefer if I sat on your lap instead?
lines.zh: : 你更希望我坐在你腿上？

lines.en: : I mean, kind of. Yeah.
lines.zh: : 我是说，有点想。对。

lines.en: I find myself killing time in my office with Chika after another average and unexciting day of[school].
lines.zh: 又是一个平淡无奇的[school]日之后，我和 Chika 在我的办公室里消磨时间。

lines.en: And by “I find myself” I mean that Chika takes it upon herself to call out of her shift tonight so she can spend more time with me.
lines.zh: 而所谓“我和 Chika”的意思是，Chika 自作主张把今晚的班翘了，好跟我多待一会儿。

lines.en: Which is fine and everything, don’t get me wrong-
lines.zh: 这当然没什么不好的，别误会——

lines.en: But I’d like to prevent the possibility of her little sister starving to death if I have anything to do with it.
lines.zh: 但只要这件事跟我有关系，我就想尽量避免她妹妹饿死的可能性。

lines.en: I know, I know. I’m such a great guy.
lines.zh: 我知道，我知道。我真是个大好人。

lines.en: : So...thanks for ghosting on me after sneaking into Ami’s dressing room the other day.
lines.zh: : 那么……谢谢你那天溜进 Ami 的更衣室之后就对我玩消失。

lines.en: : It is not “sneaking” if you specifically told me I was allowed to do that.
lines.zh: : 如果你明确说过我那么做是被允许的，那就不能算“溜”。

lines.en: : Okay, so maybe not “sneaking,” but it was still kind of weird.
lines.zh: : 好吧，也许不算“溜”，但那还是挺怪的。

lines.en: : Like, she’s your [niece]. And I’m not putting the blame on you or anything since it was clearly something you got dragged into-
lines.zh: : 比如说，她是你的 [niece]。我不是在怪你什么的，因为那明显是你被拖进去的——

lines.en: : But she should kinda like...back off, shouldn't she? It's totally weird.
lines.zh: : 但她是不是该稍微……收敛一点？这真的很怪。

lines.en: : Why are we even talking about this right now?
lines.zh: : 我们为什么要在这个时候谈这个？

lines.en: scene tsubasaofficevisit2
: Idunno, but maybe we should use this as an opportunity to segue into exactly {i}why{/i} you were in the dressing room with her.
lines.zh: : 不知道，不过也许我们该借这个机会，顺便聊聊你到底{i}为什么{/i}跟她一起待在更衣室里。

lines.en: : Are we really planning on doing a winter beach trip?
lines.zh: : 我们真的打算搞一次冬季海滩旅行吗？

lines.en: : Apparently we are. I hope you enjoy slowly freezing to death over the course of two days and one night.
lines.zh: : 看起来是。祝你享受在两天一夜里慢慢冻死的过程。

lines.en: scene tsubasaofficevisit3
: Fine by me since I can always sneak into my boyfriend’s room at night and ask him to keep me warm~
lines.zh: : 我没意见啊，反正我晚上总能溜进我男朋友的房间，让他帮我暖身子~

lines.en: : Yes, that’s a completely safe idea and I’m sure that none of your seventeen other classmates will question you mysteriously disappearing in the middle of the night.
lines.zh: : 对，这主意完全安全，而且我敢肯定，你那另外十七个同班同学绝不会对你半夜神秘失踪产生任何疑问。

lines.en: scene tsubasaofficevisit4
: It’ll probably be like nineteen by then, though. Right?
lines.zh: : 不过到那时候大概就是十九个了吧？

lines.en: : ...Does that make it any better?
lines.zh: : ……这就让它好一点了？

lines.en: : I mean, at this point, I don’t know if it would really make it {i}worse{/i}.
lines.zh: : 我是说，到这个地步，我不知道它是不是真能变得{i}更糟{/i}。

lines.en: scene tsubasaofficevisit2
: We’ve just gotta practice being sneaky or something. And obvs that starts with me coming to say hi and sitting on your desk during office hours.
lines.zh: : 我们只要练习怎么偷偷摸摸就行了。显然，这得从我在办公时间过来打招呼、坐在你桌子上开始。

lines.en: : And if you just so happen to look up my skirt or something, I can just pretend I didn’t see.
lines.zh: : 而如果你刚好往我裙子里瞄了一眼什么的，我大可以装作没看见。

lines.en: : Isn’t your girlfriend great?
lines.zh: : 你女朋友是不是很棒？

lines.en: Please stop calling yourself that before it gets any more dangerous...
lines.zh: 在事情变得更危险之前，别再这么称呼自己了……

lines.en: : Wait, how did you even know about the new transfers?
lines.zh: : 等等，你是怎么知道新转学生的事的？

lines.en: scene tsubasaofficevisit5
: Uhh...I don’t know?
lines.zh: : 呃……我不知道？

lines.en: : Makoto probably told Miku. And then Miku probably told some other people because she’s Miku. And then it somehow found its way to me.
lines.zh: : 大概是 Makoto 告诉了 Miku。然后 Miku 就是 Miku，估计又告诉了别人。然后不知怎么就传到我这儿了。

lines.en: : Do you know {i}who{/i} the transfers are, though?
lines.zh: : 那你知道转学生是{i}谁{/i}吗？

lines.en: : Not really. I just know one of them is apparently a sketch and is going to give Yumi a run for her money as class delinquent.
lines.zh: : 不太清楚。我只知道其中一个看起来很古怪，会让 Yumi 在“班级不良少女”这个位置上遇到劲敌。

lines.en: So I see Makoto spared no details (Of what little details are actually available) regarding Yasu’s expected character.
lines.zh: 看来关于 Yasu 的预期性格，Makoto 没放过任何细节（尽管实际能拿到的细节少得可怜）。

lines.en: : Got it.
lines.zh: : 明白了。

lines.en: : Oh, and also, if Makoto ever asks you if you and I went to a petting zoo together, the answer is yes.
lines.zh: : 哦，还有，如果 Makoto 问你，我们俩有没有一起去过宠物动物园，答案是去过。

lines.en: scene tsubasaofficevisit4
: Got it!
lines.zh: : 明白！

lines.en: : Really? You’re not even going to question that?
lines.zh: : 真的？你连问都不问？

lines.en: : Nah. I’m sure you’ve got your reasons.
lines.zh: : 不用。我相信你有你的理由。

lines.en: Wow. Maybe Chika actually would be a good girlfriend and I-
lines.zh: 哇。也许 Chika 真的会是个好女朋友，而我——

lines.en: Wait. What am I even thinking right now?
lines.zh: 等等。我现在到底在想什么？

lines.en: scene tsubasaofficevisit6
A knock on the door breaks the flow of our conversation and-
lines.zh: 一阵敲门声打断了我们的对话，然后——

lines.en: : Come in!
lines.zh: : 请进！

lines.en: : Wait, you can’t just invite people into my-
lines.zh: : 等等，你不能就这么把人请进我的——

lines.en: scene tsubasaofficevisit7
: Chika? What are you doing in here?
lines.zh: : Chika？你在这儿干什么？

lines.en: : I’m not interrupting something personal, am I?
lines.zh: : 我没打扰到什么私事吧？

lines.en: : Nah. I’m just talking to Sensei about the petting zoo we went to that one time.
lines.zh: : 没有。我只是在跟 Sensei 聊我们那次去的宠物动物园。

lines.en: Smooth.
lines.zh: 漂亮。

lines.en: : Right...Well, if that’s the case, this would probably be a good time to inform you that you’re not allowed to be sitting on his desk.
lines.zh: : 好吧……既然如此，那我大概该趁这个时机提醒你，你是不可以坐在他桌子上的。

lines.en: if makotolust10 == True:
Bold words for someone who literally bent over the table in the center of the room for me before.
lines.zh: 这话说得可真硬气，毕竟有个人曾经就在房间正中的那张桌子上为我弯下腰过。

lines.en: else:
Poor Makoto. She doesn’t realize that we’re definitely going to have sex on this desk sometime in the future.
lines.zh: 可怜的 Makoto。她还不知道，将来某一天我们肯定会在这张桌子上做爱。

lines.en: : It’s the misuse of[school] property and-
lines.zh: : 这是滥用[school]财物，而且——

lines.en: : Did you need something, Makoto?
lines.zh: : 你有什么事吗，Makoto？

lines.en: scene tsubasaofficevisit8
: Um...if we’re just moving along, then yes. There was something I had to discuss with Sensei regarding our newest transfer student.
lines.zh: : 嗯……如果我们要直接进入正题的话，那有的。我有件事必须和 Sensei 谈，是关于我们最新的转学生的。

lines.en: : Sensei, if you have a minute, would it be okay for me to bring in a visitor?
lines.zh: : Sensei，如果您有空的话，我带一位访客进来可以吗？

lines.en: : A visitor? You mean one that isn’t Ms. Watabe or a student?
lines.zh: : 访客？你是说不是 Watabe 老师、也不是学生的那种？

lines.en: : Correct. Though, she does seem to be rather familiar with you based on her reference to you as the...and I apologize if I am misquoting this-
lines.zh: : 没错。不过，从她提起您的方式来看，她似乎和您相当熟络——如果我引用有误，我先道个歉——

lines.en: scene tsubasaofficevisit9
: The “WAP” man?...
lines.zh: : “WAP”男人？……

lines.en: : Wait! There’s only one person I know who would ever consistently misuse that word in that way!
lines.zh: : 等等！我认识的人里，只有一个会一直以那种方式误用那个词！

lines.en: : The...what man?
lines.zh: : 什么……什么男人？

lines.en: : Come in, Tsubasa!
lines.zh: : 进来吧，Tsubasa！

lines.en: scene tsubasaofficevisit10
: Chika, please stop inviting people into my office...
lines.zh: : Chika，别再把人往我办公室里请了……

lines.en: : I apologize. Did I come at a poor time?
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我是不是来得不是时候？

lines.en: : There’s no need to apologize, Miss Tsukioka. Thank you very much for taking the time out of your busy schedule to come here today.
lines.zh: : 您不需要道歉，Tsukioka 女士。非常感谢您在百忙之中抽空前来。

lines.en: scene tsubasaofficevisit11
: Oh, there’s no need to thank me for that. I can assure you I am very much not busy.
lines.zh: : 哦，这倒不必谢我。我可以保证，我一点也不忙。

lines.en: : In fact, just being able to traverse the halls of a quaint little[school] like this has been the most fun I’ve had in quite some time.
lines.zh: : 事实上，光是能走在一所像这么古雅的小[school]的走廊里，就是我很长一段时间以来最开心的事了。

lines.en: : {i}She heard us have sex.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}她听到过我们做爱。{/i}

lines.en: : Yes, Chika. I am aware.
lines.zh: : 是的，Chika。我知道。

lines.en: : {i}She heard us have sex...{b}a lot.{/b}{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}她听到过我们做爱……{b}很多次。{/b}{/i}

lines.en: : You know, maybe it’s time for you to head home and prevent Chinami from getting sick or something?
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，也许你该回家了，去防止 Chinami 生病什么的？

lines.en: scene tsubasaofficevisit12
Chika hops off of the desk and joins Tsubasa and Makoto as they make their way to the front of it.
lines.zh: Chika 从桌子上跳下来，加入 Tsubasa 和 Makoto，一起走到桌前。

lines.en: I highly doubt Chika is going to go home yet on account of her favorite MILF showing up (Which is assuming that Chika has a secret, ranked list of MILFs), but for a brief moment in time I breathe a sigh of relief.
lines.zh: 我严重怀疑 Chika 不会就这么回家，因为她最喜欢的 MILF 出现了（前提是 Chika 真有一份秘密的 MILF 排行榜），但有那么一瞬间，我松了一口气。

lines.en: : Oh, Chika! Wonderful. I haven’t seen you since the-
lines.zh: : 哦，Chika！太好了。自从那次——我就没见过你了

lines.en: scene tsubasaofficevisit13
: Petting zoo.
lines.zh: : 宠物动物园。

lines.en: : I beg your pardon?
lines.zh: : 你说什么？

lines.en: : Is this more [young]person slang that I have yet to hear on the radio?
lines.zh: : 这又是我还没在广播里听到过的[young]人俚语吗？

lines.en: : Yup! Why are you here, though?
lines.zh: : 没错！不过你来这儿是为什么呢？

lines.en: scene tsubasaofficevisit14
: Oh, allow me to answer that.
lines.zh: : 哦，请允许我来回答。

lines.en: : In light of the recent sinkhole incident that struck Kumon-mi Academy, Miss Tsukioka has decided to enroll her daughter here at [kumon_mi_high].
lines.zh: : 鉴于最近袭击 Kumon-mi 学院的天坑事件，Tsukioka 女士决定让她的女儿转学到 [kumon_mi_high]。

lines.en: : I may have subconsciously attempted to talk her out of it on multiple occasions as I’m not sure if our...capabilities will meet her daughter’s requirements, but-
lines.zh: : 我可能在潜意识里多次试图劝她打消这个念头，因为我不确定我们的……能力能否满足她女儿的要求，不过——

lines.en: scene tsubasaofficevisit15
: Oh, please...There’s no need to be so formal. I’m sure that this[school] will work wonders for my daughter and her education.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，请……不必这么拘谨。我相信这所[school]会为我女儿的教育创造奇迹。

lines.en: : It...{i}could{/i}, under normal circumstances. But the circumstances of our classroom, which you have specifically requested for some reason, are anything but normal.
lines.zh: : 在正常情况下……{i}也许会{/i}。但我们这个班的状况——不知道为什么您偏偏指定了它——可一点也不正常。

lines.en: : It’s true. Our class is really weird.
lines.zh: : 是真的。我们班真的很怪。

lines.en: scene tsubasaofficevisit16
: If I entrust my daughter’s future to you, are you going to let me down?
lines.zh: : 如果我把女儿的未来托付给你们，你们会让我失望吗？

lines.en: : Probably.
lines.zh: : 大概会。

lines.en: : Probably.
lines.zh: : 大概会。

lines.en: : Definitely.
lines.zh: : 肯定会。

lines.en: : See?
lines.zh: : 看到了吧？

lines.en: : They’re just being humble, I’m sure.
lines.zh: : 我相信他们只是谦虚而已。

lines.en: : You recently took on the Nagasawa girl, didn’t you? Between her and my little tour guide here, that would mean you have the two highest scoring girls in the entire district.
lines.zh: : 你们最近收了 Nagasawa 家的女孩，对吧？她和我的这位小导游加在一起，就等于你们拥有整个学区分数最高的两个女孩。

lines.en: scene tsubasaofficevisit17
: Right...
lines.zh: : 是啊……

lines.en: : I guess the days of me being the smartest girl in[school] are over now, huh?
lines.zh: : 我想，我是[school]里最聪明的女孩的日子，到此为止了，是吧？

lines.en: : You’ll catch up in due time, dear. I was never quite fond of that Nagasawa girl to begin with.
lines.zh: : 你早晚会赶上的，亲爱的。我从一开始就不太喜欢那个 Nagasawa 家的女孩。

lines.en: : She is...quite peculiar.
lines.zh: : 她……相当古怪。

lines.en: scene tsubasaofficevisit18
: I’d also like it to be known that it wasn’t just the presence of those two bright, [young]stars that forced my hand in making this decision.
lines.zh: : 我还想说明一点，促使我做出这个决定的，并不仅仅是这两位耀眼的[young]明星在场。

lines.en: : What was it then? Because I was pretty confident my first impression was...not very good.
lines.zh: : 那是什么？因为我相当确信，我给您留下的第一印象……可不怎么好。

lines.en: scene tsubasaofficevisit19
: It was what this girl right here had to say about you during a lengthy conversation at the {i}petting zoo{/i} about the way you make her feel.
lines.zh: : 是这位姑娘在{i}宠物动物园{/i}里，跟我长谈时说起——你让她有怎样的感受时——所说的话。

lines.en: : That told me everything I needed to know about you as a teacher.
lines.zh: : 那让我对身为老师的您，有了足够充分的了解。

lines.en: : And while your methods are certainly...unorthodox, I am going to assume that was simply due to the fact that it was a special occasion.
lines.zh: : 虽然您的方法确实……不按常理出牌，但我姑且认为，那只是因为那天是个特殊的场合。

lines.en: scene tsubasaofficevisit20
: My daughter does not have a very easy time...opening up to people.
lines.zh: : 我女儿很难……向别人敞开心扉。

lines.en: : She is a wonderful [young_girl]...and extremely dedicated when it comes to both the family business as well as her academic life.
lines.zh: : 她是个很出色的 [young_girl]……而且无论是对家族事业还是学业，都极其投入。

lines.en: : But she has a history of being rather...uninspired when it comes to those who have been fortunate enough to teach her.
lines.zh: : 但说到那些有幸教过她的人，她一向……提不起兴趣。

lines.en: : And so, in knowing that you are able to see your students as more than just minds to mold, I’ve decided to take a leap of faith and put her in your hands.
lines.zh: : 所以，知道您能够把学生看作不只是等待塑造的头脑之后，我决定冒险相信一次，把她交到您手里。

lines.en: scene tsubasaofficevisit21
: I can’t guarantee she’ll be entirely cooperative to begin with, but I can assure you that she is unreasonably kind at heart and wants nothing more than to fit in.
lines.zh: : 我不能保证她一开始会完全配合，但我可以保证，她内心善良得不合常理，而且一心只想融入大家。

lines.en: You know, only I would be lucky enough to somehow gain the trust of the wealthiest woman in Kumon-mi by audibly deflowering a girl the same age as her daughter in the room right next door.
lines.zh: 你知道吗，也只有我这种人才能走这种狗屎运——在隔壁房间里把一个和她女儿同龄的女孩开苞，声音还全被她听了去，反而因此赢得了 Kumon-mi 最富有的女人的信任。

lines.en: : I mean...if that’s what you think is best for her, she can definitely hang out.
lines.zh: : 我是说……如果您认为这对她最好，她绝对可以来“待着”。

lines.en: scene tsubasaofficevisit22
: {i}Hang out.{/i} I love that! It’s so informal that it’s as if you don’t view your students as students at all.
lines.zh: : “{i}待着{/i}”。我喜欢这个说法！随意得就好像您根本没把学生当成学生。

lines.en: : Yes. That exact principle is the single largest pillar in my teaching strategy.
lines.zh: : 对。这条原则正是我教学策略中最大的支柱。

lines.en: : I mean...it’s certainly not {i}not{/i} working?
lines.zh: : 我是说……这也不能说{i}没有{/i}效果？

lines.en: : Yeah. Weirdly enough, having someone like Sensei around is the exact motivation I needed to really start putting myself back on track.
lines.zh: : 是啊。说来也怪，身边有 Sensei 这样的人，正是我重新走上正轨所需要的动力。

lines.en: : And, if your daughter is anything at all like you, I’m sure that she and I will get along great.
lines.zh: : 而且，如果您女儿有半点像您，我相信她和我一定会相处得很好。

lines.en: scene tsubasaofficevisit23
: That would mean so much to me, dear. Please make her feel at home if at all possible.
lines.zh: : 那对我来说意义重大，亲爱的。如果可能的话，请让她有宾至如归的感觉。

lines.en: : Of course! Anything for you, Tsubasa!
lines.zh: : 当然！为了您什么都行，Tsubasa！

lines.en: The gap between first and second place on Chika’s secret MILF ranking widens.
lines.zh: Chika 秘密 MILF 排行榜上，第一名与第二名的差距又拉大了。

lines.en: : Well...I guess that’s that, then.
lines.zh: : 那么……我想就是这样了。

lines.en: : Miss Tsukioka just wanted to formally touch base with you and confirm that you were, indeed, the “WAP” man.
lines.zh: : Tsukioka 女士只是想正式跟您碰个面，确认您确实就是那位“WAP”男人。

lines.en: : I have decided to embrace my poor usage of the “WAP” and convert it into a multifunctional tool for describing good people!
lines.zh: : 我决定坦然接受我对“WAP”这个词的糟糕用法，并把它改造成一个多功能的工具，用来形容好人！

lines.en: : {i}Cooooooool.{/i}
scene tsubasaofficevisit24
: So, would this Friday work as her first day in your class?
lines.zh: : 那么，这周五作为她来您班上的第一天，可以吗？

lines.en: : We’re still in the process of relocating her to a second, smaller house in the area so the commute will be less strenuous on her, but we should be finished within the next day or two.
lines.zh: : 我们还在把她的东西搬到这附近第二处更小的房子，这样她通勤就不会太辛苦，不过一两天之内应该就能弄完。

lines.en: : You’re...getting her her own house?
lines.zh: : 你们……要给她一整栋房子？

lines.en: : Of course. It’s the very least we can do to reward her for all of this.
lines.zh: : 当然。这是我们能做到的最起码的事，作为对这一切的奖励。

lines.en: : She was quite resistant to the idea at first, actually. But she eventually came around after seeing how many people were flocking to this[school].
lines.zh: : 其实她一开始相当抗拒这个主意。但看到这么多人涌向这所[school]之后，她最终还是想通了。

lines.en: : That’s great and all, but she could just move into the dorms instead. She doesn’t need a whole house.
lines.zh: : 那当然很好，但她也可以直接搬进宿舍啊。她不需要一整栋房子。

lines.en: : Ooooooh, I see. I see.
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦，我懂了。我懂了。

lines.en: : But, what is a “dorm” exactly?
lines.zh: : 不过，“宿舍”到底是什么呢？

lines.en: : It’s like...an apartment specifically designed for people attending[school].
lines.zh: : 就是……专门给上学的人住的一种公寓。

lines.en: : My, that sounds like it would be absolutely splendid once she’s ready for it.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，等她准备好了，那听起来绝对棒极了。

lines.en: : But I do think we should at least wait to see if she’s able to seamlessly transition into the actual[school] first before making a commitment like that.
lines.zh: : 但我确实认为，至少应该先看看她能不能无缝过渡到真正的[school]生活，再做那种承诺。

lines.en: : Hey, whatever works for you. She’s your daughter. I’m just some guy that's going to be around her pretty frequently from now on.
lines.zh: : 嘿，您觉得怎么合适就怎么来。她是您的女儿。我只是从现在开始会经常出现在她身边的某个家伙而已。

lines.en: : Not {i}too{/i} frequently, though. You’ve got...other obligations.
lines.zh: : 但也别{i}太{/i}频繁。您还有……别的义务。

lines.en: : Precisely. Like your paperwork and spending time showing your glorified secretary how much you appreciate all she does for you.
lines.zh: : 正是。比如您的文书工作，还有花时间向您那位被捧上天的秘书表达您对她所做一切的感激。

lines.en: : Yup. Exactly what I’m talking about. Definitely not anything else.
lines.zh: : 对。我说的就是这个。绝对不是别的什么。

lines.en: : Oh my...I can feel the secondhand excitement bubbling up within me by the second.
lines.zh: : 哎呀……我能感觉到那份二手的兴奋正一秒一秒地在我体内冒泡。

lines.en: : Perhaps I should also transfer into this[school]?
lines.zh: : 也许我也该转学到这所[school]来？

lines.en: scene tsubasaofficevisit25
: Let’s just...focus on your daughter for right now instead...
lines.zh: : 我们还是……先专注在您女儿身上吧……

lines.en: scene black
The three girls leave the office moments later and I take a couple hours to {i}actually do some paperwork{/i} before heading out myself.
lines.zh: 三个女孩片刻之后离开了办公室，我花了几个小时{i}真的做了些文书工作{/i}，然后才自己离开。

lines.en: I figure it’s the least I can do to not only lessen some of the burden on Makoto, but to reward her for putting together this entire rich girl transfer operation.
lines.zh: 我想，这是我至少能做的事——既能减轻 Makoto 的一些负担，也能犒劳她把这场“富家女转学行动”整个操办下来。

lines.en: I just hope the process for our final student goes just as smoothly...
lines.zh: 我只希望我们最后那位学生的流程，也能同样顺利……
